label: fs-20260926-p-offline-summary-trn21-r2
assembly: Copy exactly proposal's86 named files into new input/native preserving directories. Parent streams/hashes within fixed slot and makes copies read-only. No hardlinks/reflinks/flattening/arbitrary NEFF selection.
resource_limit_detail: Parent CPU soft55 with failure handler before decoder fork, then hard60; version child hard5. Decoder gets min(235,floor(300-60-32-actual preceding child CPU)) seconds, normally at most207/208, reserving32 for two final15s idle checks on inherited single-CPU affinity. These are stricter subdivisions of the original300 CPU ceiling, never a raised limit. Parent AS soft512MiB/hard16GiB permits child hard16GiB without raising inherited hard bounds. RLIMIT_AS is per-process virtual address space, not a cgroup RSS guarantee. Observed unexpected descendants fail closed and are terminated by tracked PID/start identity; no cgroup claim. Generated scratch is sampled, not a quota; retain overshoot. No relaxation/retry on failure. Linux self-process CHILD_SUBREAPER is required before spawn so fast double-forks remain owned; unavailable support refuses without a decoder attempt. R2 exception: only the bounded shared pre/post readiness call temporarily uses the existing16GiB soft AS ceiling for inherited ps/neuron-ls; finally restores parent512MiB before other work. No decoder or hard ceiling increase.16GiB Go compatibility remains unproved.
postflight: Same lifetime lock; exact owned PID/start identities stopped if necessary, shared ps/neuron-ls before releasing. Operator then separately records original lock free and explicit PID/PPID/PGID/SID of any suspect descendants. No next job on unknown quiescence.
wait_for: All prior trn21 work and failed r1 must be terminal/retrieved/explicitly quiescent; independent repair review and new sole Operator release required. Original inode596823/device66305, fresh in-lock ps+neuron-ls and all resource/STOP checks mandatory.
actual_binary_pin: Archived exact version plus observed pre/post binary SHA/inode/metadata recorded at runtime; current binary content hash not previously available. Unsupported binary path, version, size>256MiB or symlink refuses.

repair.scope: Only wrap unchanged pre/post readiness in existing16GiB soft AS, restore512MiB in finally; unique r2 root/label/pins. Helper and all ceilings unchanged.
